about.title: About us
about.intro: Consulting focused on technology and operational improvement in demanding industrial environments — field presence and management perspective.
paragraphs: Jatoba Consulting & Technology grew out of the founder’s hands-on track record in the offshore drilling industry — over two decades in critical operations, operational management, maintenance, reliability, and continuous process improvement.

We bring together professionals skilled in automation, electronics, real-time data transmission, and technology solutions applied to industrial operations. Our focus is turning operational data into visibility, control, and decision support.

Our methodology was built where safety, availability, and operational efficiency are non-negotiable. We bring that discipline to industries that depend on critical assets yet still face limited data integration and field visibility.

More than consulting, we deliver integration across operations, technology, and management — connecting people, processes, and equipment to improve reliability, cut losses, and raise operational performance.

whyUs.title: Why clients choose us
whyUs.intro: We turn operational experience in critical environments into hands-on technology, maintenance, and performance solutions. We work where lost time means direct loss — bringing visibility, control, and efficiency to industrial operations.
items: Consolidated field experience
Operational discipline and KPI-led management
Technology that creates visibility for assets and processes
Fast response with a focus on operational continuity
Planned maintenance with real execution and follow-up
Field data turned into actionable information
Process standardisation and less dependence on key individuals
Safety culture embedded in daily operations
Simple, useful, outcome-driven solutions
whyUs.closing: We understand what happens in operations, what leadership needs to see, and what must improve to sustain results where assets are critical.

sectors.title: Sectors we serve
sectors.intro: We operate in oil, gas, and energy — from offshore drilling to infrastructure, with the same operational discipline.

items.title: Oil & gas
items.description: Our roots lie in offshore drilling — environments where safety, reliability, and efficiency are decisive. That is where we built the methodology we now apply in other industrial sectors.

items.title: Process industries
items.description: We bring offshore drilling discipline to plants that cannot stop: NPT reduction, asset integrity, maintenance, and operational visibility — connecting processes and equipment that often still run without structured data.

items.title: Energy & infrastructure
items.description: Technology and operational management for distributed assets, reactive maintenance, and limited field visibility. We integrate data transmission, dashboards, and indicators to strengthen control, reliability, and decision-making.

privacyPage.title: Privacy policy
privacyPage.p1: This policy describes how the Jatoba Consulting and Technology (“Jatoba”) institutional website may process personal information provided by visitors, in line with applicable law and sound practice.
privacyPage.p2: When you use contact forms or e-mail channels, you may provide details such as your name, company, phone number, and e-mail address. We use this information solely to respond to enquiries and pursue legitimate business discussions about Jatoba services.
privacyPage.p3: Jatoba applies reasonable safeguards to protect information from unauthorised access or misuse. We do not sell personal data to third parties. Technology providers involved in hosting or transactional mail may receive strictly limited technical access under appropriate contracts and confidentiality duties.
privacyPage.p4: Where applicable, you may ask to correct or delete contact details submitted via this website by reaching out through the Contact section.
privacyPage.p5: Cookies and similar technologies may be used only for site functionality or aggregated audience analytics; further detail can be reflected here once the final technical setup is confirmed.
